snippet.title: Michael Taught Prince How To Tie A Tie & Now He's Carrying That With Him Forever 💔🖤 #shorts
snippet.description:

Prince shared that it was Michael who taught him how to tie a tie. Just a regular dad moment. Except now every single time he does it — his dad is right there with him. No fanfare, no spotlight. Just a memory wrapped around his collar.


And then there's Bigi — who personally reached out to Michael Bush, the man who designed so many of MJ's most iconic looks, to create their outfits for the movie premiere. That wasn't the team's idea. That wasn't planned by anyone. That was a kid who wanted his dad present in that moment the only way he could make it happen.


Full circle doesn't even cover it. This is something else entirely. 🖤

snippet.title: Michael Jackson’s Children Finally OPEN UP About Their Father, And It’s Emotional
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson’s Children Finally OPEN UP About Their Father, And It’s Emotional


Michael Jackson’s children—Prince, Paris, and Bigi—have spent most of their lives avoiding the spotlight, which is exactly why their rare public comments feel so powerful. In this compilation, you’ll hear them describe a father who wasn’t performing “Michael Jackson” at home—he was simply “Dad.” Prince remembers being taught storytelling through classic cinema, with Michael pausing scenes to explain timing, emotion, and why certain moments stayed with audiences. Paris shares some of the most emotional words ever spoken about him, defending his role as a loving parent and recalling everyday memories that contrast sharply with the public myths. Bigi’s rare remarks focus less on fame and more on responsibility—especially protecting the planet and carrying forward values tied to compassion and humanitarian work.
Alongside the family perspective, the video includes reflections from friends and artists who worked with him, describing his discipline, creativity, and how deeply he influenced modern performance. This is not a verdict—it’s a collection of voices that shows how one person can be remembered in many different ways.
#MichaelJackson #ParisJackson #PrinceJackson #BigiJackson #KingOfPop

snippet.title: How Michael Jackson Destroyed Eminem!
snippet.description: Why do Eminem and Michael Jackson have beef? Michael Jackson is the only person to get revenge on Eminem, it all started in 2004 when Eminem released the song, “Just Lose it.” The song roasted every part of Jackson’s career and talked about his plastic surgeries. In the music video, Eminem mocked Jackson by lighting his hair on fire and cutting off his nose. The song went double platinum and the entire world saw it, Michael said the song caused him a lot of pain especially since he respected Eminem as an artist. Jackson was so mad at Eminem that he tried to sue him and get the song banned. But after years of being unsuccessful, Jackson decided to use his power and take the beef to the next level. So instead of taking legal action, Jackson bought Eminem’s entire music catalog for $300 million. After the purchase, he basically owned Eminem and made him be quiet for the rest of history.
